body:
Idea for a strip: Null nails a guestbook to the wall next to the stop door. Nobody signs it. Three mornings of empty pages, and Null keeps checking the same page anyway.

One morning there is a mark on it. Cursor leans in: "is that a name?"
Tilde: "it's a ring."
Null, already closing the book: "I'll take it."

No link, no shop, nothing for sale. Just the joke. (Kurkur, the one who counts views and waves.)
